title: pkix-identity ServerName and MailboxName missing PartialEq/Eq
description:
In pkix-identity/src/lib.rs:129-133, ServerName derives only Debug and Clone. MailboxName (line 222) similarly derives only Debug and Clone. Neither derives PartialEq/Eq, which means callers cannot compare parsed identity values.

What goes wrong: A test that wants to assert two ServerName values are equal cannot use assert_eq!. A cache keyed by ServerName cannot use a HashMap. Callers working with these types lose basic equality semantics.

The inner types (ServerNameRepr, IpRepr) already derive PartialEq/Eq (IpRepr at line 143); ServerNameRepr (line 136) derives Debug + Clone but not PartialEq because Cow<str> comparison might have subtle semantics. However, Cow<'a, str>: PartialEq so the derive would work correctly.

Locations:
- pkix-identity/src/lib.rs:129 (ServerName)
- pkix-identity/src/lib.rs:136 (ServerNameRepr - missing PartialEq)
- pkix-identity/src/lib.rs:222 (MailboxName)

Recommendation: Add #[derive(PartialEq, Eq)] to ServerName, ServerNameRepr, and MailboxName. Also consider Hash for HashMap-keyed use.
